Maison.title: Maison Soleil: from platform dependency to direct control
Maison.lead: Andrew Gee has run Maison Soleil in the Seychelles since 2009. The property was exceptional. The digital foundation was not.
story: For years, the retreat relied on an outdated website and heavy dependence on third-party platforms that took high commissions and diluted the guest relationship.
That meant less control, less margin, and a brand experience that did not match the standard of the place itself.
We rebuilt the entire digital foundation: a professional website, a direct booking system, and strategic automation so Maison Soleil could attract and convert guests on its own terms.
Maison.shift: From renting distribution to owning the path from discovery to booking — and keeping more of every stay.

points.label: Before
points.text: Outdated site, platform commissions, fragile control over how guests arrived.

points.label: After
points.text: Direct booking infrastructure, clearer brand presence, systems that support independent growth.
